nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Short reference note explaining that the CRD YAML files in deploy/crds are source material used to build the officially supported deployment manifests (e.g. the Helm chart) and are not intended for direct use by end users.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub blockquote syntax for the end-user warning admonition.

nodes.name: acme.cert-manager.io_challenges.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the ACME Challenge resource (challenges.acme.cert-manager.io, v1) defining the full OpenAPI schema for in-flight ACME challenge validation, including solver configuration, DNS-01/HTTP-01 status fields, and challenge state.
nodes.languageNotes: Large generated structural schema (3,476 lines) with deeply nested per-solver properties and x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields free-form blocks.

nodes.name: acme.cert-manager.io_orders.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the ACME Order resource (orders.acme.cert-manager.io, v1) describing the schema of an ACME order, its authorizations, identifiers, and certificate request references.
nodes.languageNotes: Compact generated CRD with a single served/storage version and nested status subresource schema.

nodes.name: cert-manager.io_certificaterequests.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the CertificateRequest resource (certificaterequests.cert-manager.io, v1), defining the CSR payload, issuer reference, and issued certificate response schema.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes shortNames for kubectl and a status subresource carrying base64-encoded certificate data.

nodes.name: cert-manager.io_certificates.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the Certificate resource (certificates.cert-manager.io, v1) covering desired certificate specs such as secretName, dnsNames, issuers, keystores, and renewal policy along with status conditions.
nodes.languageNotes: Nested keystore and secret template schemas show heavy use of x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields for user-supplied labels and annotations.

nodes.name: cert-manager.io_clusterissuers.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the ClusterIssuer resource (clusterissuers.cert-manager.io, v1), defining the cluster-scoped issuer schema with ACME, CA, Vault, Venafi, and self-signed issuer configurations.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest CRD in the batch (4,068 lines) mirroring the namespaced Issuer schema with deeply nested per-issuer-type configuration and solver selectors.

nodes.name: cert-manager.io_issuers.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the namespaced Issuer resource (issuers.cert-manager.io, v1), defining issuer backend configuration for ACME, CA, Vault, Venafi, and self-signed issuers plus their status conditions.
nodes.languageNotes: Nearly identical in size and structure to the ClusterIssuer CRD, differing mainly in scope and metadata.
